$comment: Hand-edited input for tools/build-manifest.mjs. Everything here is merged on top of the data pulled from each addon repo's package.json / GitHub metadata. Edit this file, never manifest.json.

registry.name: Polyphase Engine Recomps Addons
registry.description: Addon registry for Polyphase Engine Recomps: native runtimes for games recompiled from community decompilation projects. Machine-readable index of every recomp addon, its metadata, dependencies and download locations, so the engine and tooling never have to crawl GitHub to resolve an addon. No game code or assets are distributed; each port builds against the user's own legally obtained copy.

categories.name: Base
categories.description: Shared layers used by every recomp runtime (mod support, settings, scaling).

categories.name: Platforms
categories.description: Per-console runtimes that replace the original hardware and SDK so decompiled games build and run natively.

categories.name: Games
categories.description: Game packages that build a specific decompiled game against a platform runtime.

com.recomp.mod.base.name: Recomp Mod Base
com.recomp.mod.base.summary: Mod layer shared by the recomp runtimes: mod maps, mod settings, generated settings UI, resolution scaler and Recomp/Mods Lua.

com.recomp.netplay.name: Recomp Netplay
com.recomp.netplay.summary: Networked multiplayer for the recomp runtimes (N64 first): lockstep input sync over UDP, LAN discovery and IP:port joining, save sync and desync detection.

com.recomp.gba.name: Game Boy Advance (GBA) Recomp
com.recomp.gba.summary: Shared runtime for native GBA ports, with the GbaPlayer node that plays a decompiled game in Polyphase.

com.recomp.gcn.name: Nintendo GameCube (GCN) Recomp
com.recomp.gcn.summary: GameCube recompilation runtime that builds decompiled GameCube games natively and plays them with the GcnPlayer node.

com.recomp.n64.name: Nintendo 64 (N64) Recomp
com.recomp.n64.summary: Shared runtime for natively compiled N64 decomps: libultra shim, F3DEX2 renderer, audio and host backends.

com.recomp.ps1.name: PlayStation (PS1) Recomp
com.recomp.ps1.summary: PS1 recompilation runtime that builds fully decompiled PS1 games natively and plays them with the Ps1Player node.
